verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at the site root and Markdown versions of the docs pages, which point agents to a full documentation index at /docs/llms.txt. Further .md pages exist (cli.md, independence.md, mcp-v2/auto-fix.md), and the CLI onboarding page says you can hand it to your coding agent to run setup. missing for 10: no community or hands-on report of agents actually consuming these docs successfully, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or of how complete the index is.
